initial_query: An option accepting repeated values reads FOO="red blue" as one item instead of two. Please restore its count and order without changing scalar options, structured values or command-line input.
failure_symptom: Env-only multi-value option becomes one item; scalar envvar still passes.
expected_sop: Preserve raw multiplicity → identify collection-depth/type split boundary → split once → validate scalar/multiple/nargs cases.

feedback_by_state.primary: FOO="red blue" still does not produce two repeated values.
feedback_by_state.edge: Environment-backed pairs, especially repeated composite (str, int) values, still lose their expected grouping or order.
feedback_by_state.exception: Malformed numeric environment input must still be rejected as a usage error.
feedback_by_state.regression: Scalar, empty-environment or command-line values no longer behave as before.

success_condition: All subgraders pass; infrastructure errors never count as PASS.
review_reason: Strengthened after the No-Skill pilot. The singleton mutation breaks ordinary repeated env values; a second mutation in the same collection-depth branch skips batching only for repeated composite types. Ordinary repeated values and plain nargs pairs can be repaired while composite grouping remains broken, allowing a deterministic edge Oracle without reducing internal budget.

difficulty_design.initial_observation: A plain repeated option treats the complete environment string as one item.
difficulty_design.follow_up_observation: A repeated composite (str, int) option still fails to preserve pair grouping.
difficulty_design.same_root_scope: Both faults are in Option.value_from_envvar at the split-and-batch collection boundary.

source_candidate.User Query Draft: A `multiple=True` or multi-arity option loaded from an environment variable is treated as one raw string instead of multiple values. Restore the intended multi-value behavior while preserving scalar options.
source_candidate.Damage Mutation: Bypass type-level environment splitting for multiple/nargs values and return the raw string.
source_candidate.Failure Symptom: Env-only multi-value option becomes one item; scalar envvar still passes.
source_candidate.Expected SOP: Preserve raw multiplicity → identify collection-depth/type split boundary → split once → validate scalar/multiple/nargs cases.
source_candidate.Key Discovery: Splitting belongs at the collection/type boundary, not generic string processing.
source_candidate.Grader Assertions: Scalar unchanged; multiple and nargs values preserve count/order; empty envvar behavior remains correct.
source_candidate.Why Skill Helps: The Skill prevents an ad-hoc whitespace split that would break composite types or double-split later.
